verified_facts.text: D Maris Bay's secluded cove is set in the protected reservation area of the Datca Peninsula, on Turkey's Turquoise Coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in the protected reservation area of the Datça Peninsula, D Maris Bay’s secluded cove is tucked away in a serene corner of Turkey's Turquoise Coast.

verified_facts.text: The resort sits on a pine-covered hillside.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched at heady heights on a pine-covered hillside, D Maris Bay is surrounded by nature’s most exquisite artistry.

verified_facts.text: The bay is where the Aegean meets the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Swathes of white sand and every shade of blue you could ever imagine: where the Aegean meets the Mediterranean.

verified_facts.text: D Maris Bay is 130 km from Dalaman International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: You will find D Maris Bay here: 130 km from Dalaman International Airport.

verified_facts.text: The resort is 155 km from Bodrum Airport and 35 km from the city of Marmaris.
verified_facts.excerpt:
155 km from Bodrum Airport
35km from city of Marmaris

verified_facts.text: The sea around the resort is home to marine life including rare loggerhead sea turtles and monk seals.
verified_facts.excerpt: the sea is home to marine life including rare loggerhead sea turtles and monk seals

verified_facts.text: The Bay Beach is a spacious, family-friendly white-sand beach at the heart of the bay, with the Kids Club just around the corner.
verified_facts.excerpt: This spacious, white-sand beach is a family-friendly paradise at the heart of the bay. Swim, splash and snorkel in crystal-clear waters, spotting turtles and fish, and keep kids entertained all day with the Kids Club just around the corner.

verified_facts.text: Maris Beach is a palm-dotted beach with a beachside spa treatment room, private cabanas (one with its own Jacuzzi) and a floating daybed suspended above the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: This exclusive slice of peaceful, palm-dotted beach offers a beachside spa treatment room and private cabanas, one with its own luxurious Jacuzzi. A coveted floating daybed, suspended above the sea, makes for magical memories.

verified_facts.text: Hidden Beach offers a private cabana on a pristine shoreline with personalized services.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your own private paradise and a pristine shoreline all to yourself in a private cabana equipped with all the essentials at Hidden Beach.

verified_facts.text: La Guerite Beach is a private, palm-fringed stretch of sand with raffia-shaded loungers, canopied daybeds and sunset DJ sets.
verified_facts.excerpt: A private stretch of palm-fringed sand is speckled with raffia-shaded loungers and white canopied daybeds. Sip on bubbles between ocean swims, as tropical house music lilts through the air. Later, the beach pulses to life with sunset DJ sets

verified_facts.text: Zuma x Silence Beach is a serene beach without music, with floating daybeds above the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: invites you to unwind without music or distractions, where lying on a floating daybed above the sea becomes a moment of pure stillness.

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature Italian marble and polished teak wood, with sea or mountain views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spacious, airy rooms, flooded with light, boast Italian marble and polished teak tree wood. Choose a sea view for spellbinding vistas of the bay, or opt for the dramatic scenery of the mountains.

verified_facts.text: Suites have views over the bay or volcanic mountains and details such as travertine stone.
verified_facts.excerpt: with sweeping views over the bay or volcanic mountains. Elegant details, such as sleek travertine stone, set suites apart in next-level luxury.

verified_facts.text: The D Maris Bay Villa has its own private pool in lush gardens, Calacatta marble bathrooms, a Gaggenau kitchen and 24-hour butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: The sprawling 310-sqm D Maris Bay Villa is an indulgent hideaway complete with its own private pool in vivid, lush gardens. Bathrooms are adorned in Calacatta marble

verified_facts.text: The villa's Gaggenau kitchen has 24-hour butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your fully-equipped Gaggenau kitchen has 24-hour butler service, a wine cooler and a dining room that hosts up to 8 people.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a terrace with a Jacuzzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: 115 sqm terrace with Jacuzzi

verified_facts.text: Rooms have housekeeping twice a day and 24-hour room service.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Housekeeping service twice a day
- 24-hour room service

verified_facts.text: Mytha Spa draws its inspiration from nature.
verified_facts.excerpt: Honour your inner rhythm at Mytha Spa, where inspiration draws on nature to create an otherworldly wellness experience

verified_facts.text: Fitness offerings include sunrise yoga, fitness classes and a fully-equipped D-Gym.
verified_facts.excerpt: From meditative sunrise yoga to exhilarating fitness classes and a fully-equipped D-Gym

verified_facts.text: A specialist watersports centre offers wakeboarding, sailing, surfing, kayaking, diving and waterskiing with expert instructors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wakeboarding, sailing, surfing, kayaking, diving and waterskiing are all on offer at our specialist watersports centre, with expert instructors to show you the ropes.

verified_facts.text: Guests can rent a catamaran to explore hidden coves and nearby islands, or take lessons at the international sailing school.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spend a relaxed day exploring hidden coves and nearby islands with a catamaran rental, available for up to 10 guests plus crew. For a more high-octane adventure, take a lesson with one of our expert instructors at the international sailing school

verified_facts.text: Private helicopter tours fly over the coastline of the Datca Peninsula.
verified_facts.excerpt: Soar above the rugged coastline and azure seas of the Datça Peninsula on a private helicopter tour

verified_facts.text: The resort has tennis hard courts and a padel court.
verified_facts.excerpt: you can work up a sweat with a few sets on our hard courts — or enjoy an energizing game on our brand-new padel court.

verified_facts.text: The Maris Kids Club works with Worldwide Kids, a luxury childcare provider.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Maris Kids Club proudly joins forces with Worldwide Kids, the world's leading luxury childcare provider

verified_facts.text: Restaurants include Zuma, Nusr-Et, Aurora Capri, Manos, La Guerite and D Maris Kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt:
- 01 Nusr-et
- 02 D Maris Kitchen
- 03 Manos
- 04 La Guérite
- 05 Zuma
- 08 Aurora Capri

verified_facts.text: Pomegranates from the resort's own gardens flavour signature dishes and cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Jewel-toned pomegranates from our very own gardens provide a rich, traditional flavour for a number of our signature dishes and cocktails.

verified_facts.text: Boutiques carry resort collections from designers including Stella McCartney, M Missoni and Moschino.
verified_facts.excerpt: A number of high-end boutiques carry men’s and women’s resort collections, accessories and jewellery from sought-after international designers, including Stella McCartney, M Missoni and Moschino.

verified_facts.excerpt: Spacious, modern minimalism meets Eastern luxury in this idyllic beachfront hotel.

verified_facts.excerpt: one of six private beaches and two shimmering pools
